description: The removal of existing pole-mounted antenna and the installation of a 25m monopole, six antenna apertures, eight cabinets and ancillary development thereto
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 002 Site Location Plan; 100 Existing Site Plan; 150 Existing Elevation A; 215 Max Configuration Site Plan; 265 Max Configuration Elevation; Unnumbered INCIRP Declaration dated 23/08/2019; Unnumbered Supplementary Information. Received: 08/10/2019. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Within 28 calendar days of the date of the apparatus hereby approved coming into use, the date of which shall be notified in writing to the Local Planning Authority no less than 14 calendar days prior, the existing apparatus shall be dismantled and removed from the site, including all associated debris.
